title: Select
description: Fiori select with the SAP keyboard model (arrows change value while closed; F4 / Alt+↓ open).

usage.summary: Choose one value from a short predefined list without entering free text.
useWhen: Let users choose one predefined value from 2–12 options without entering free text.
Keep options collapsed when users do not need to compare every answer at once.
Order options meaningfully; sort alphabetically when there are more than 8 options.
Offer a useful initial choice with defaultValue, or control value with onValueChange.

avoidWhen.when: Narrow one choice by typing, typically across 20–200 options, or accept free text with suggestions; use Input when no suggestions or choice list is needed.
Collect several values: fewer than 200 predefined options need MultiComboBox; caller-validated entries or datasets above 200 need MultiInput.
Find a value above 200 entries, search several attributes, or define conditions.
Keep every form answer visible with RadioGroup, change compact related views with SegmentedButton, or create and manage saved views with VariantManagement.
Browse business items with List, expand a hierarchy with Tree, or inspect repeated row attributes with Table rather than choose a field value.
